changeSet.comment: Practices decide outcomes from answered questions. Every reviewed practice, its current revision, every reviewed instance override and every adopted base gains a holistic judgment that restates what its criteria already asked: whether the occasion arises, whether the standard is met, and how severe a shortfall is. Earlier revisions keep no judgment, because they never asked these questions. Observations gain the answers and the deciding rule; earlier observations keep none. INFO severities become MINOR, the band that keeps a specific edit to make.

rollback.stop: Restore a verified database backup made before the practice judgment cutover. The holistic judgments given to existing practices and the INFO severities mapped to MINOR cannot be told apart from later edits.
